items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's National Archives Administration on Monday marked the 40th anniversary of Taipei Zoo's move on Sept. 14, 1986, by inviting the public to revisit historic photos of the move on its website.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Archives Administration celebrated the 40th anniversary of Taipei Zoo's relocation in 1986. The agency invited the public to view historic photos of the move on its website.

items.raw_excerpt: Every autumn, Munich’s Theresienwiese transforms into the site of the world’s largest folk festival. With upwards of six million visitors expected from around the globe, we’d love to hear your advice on how to make the most of the experience - or just survive.
items.summary_en: Every autumn, Munich's Theresienwiese becomes the site of the world's largest folk festival. Over six million visitors come from around the globe. The Local asks readers to share tips for making the most of the experience, or just surviving it.

items.raw_excerpt: With the verdict in that speaking Italian is key to life in Italy, foreign residents share their tips and tricks for mastering the language.
items.summary_en: Foreign residents in Italy share advice on mastering the Italian language. They say the key is to embrace mistakes and laugh at yourself when you get words wrong. Learning Italian helps you feel more at home in your new community.

items.raw_excerpt: Great news for commuters in Oslo as public transport monthly passes in Zone 1 will see a significant price cut, falling by 160 kroner.
items.summary_en: Oslo is cutting the price of its Zone 1 monthly public transport pass by 160 kroner. The new rate is the lowest it has been in nearly 30 years. The change is good news for daily commuters in the city.

items.raw_excerpt: The cabinet has published its plan to reform the Dutch public broadcasting system, which will replace the current 11 broadcasting organisations with four “broadcasting houses” from 2029. News broadcaster NOS and educational broadcaster NTR will also merge under the NOS name, and no new broadcasters will be allowed to join the system, media minister Rianne Letschert told parliament on Friday, NOS reported. The plan was first drawn up last year and was included in the coalition agreement and is op
items.summary_en: The Dutch government plans to replace its 11 public broadcasting organisations with four "broadcasting houses" starting in 2029. News broadcaster NOS and educational broadcaster NTR will merge under the NOS name. No new broadcasters will be allowed to join the system.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부가 현재 11개인 공영방송을 2029년부터 4개 방송국으로 줄이는 개편안을 발표했다. 뉴스 방송국 NOS와 교육 방송국 NTR은 NOS 이름 아래 합쳐진다. 앞으로 새로운 방송국의 참가는 허용되지 않는다.

items.raw_excerpt: Portaria da Cultura palacete Celina Guinle e Linneo de Paula Machado e seus jardins. Medida foi publicada nesta segunda no Diário Oficial.
items.summary_en: The Brazilian Ministry of Culture has officially listed the Celina Guinle and Linneo de Paula Machado palace in Rio de Janeiro as protected cultural heritage. The historic palace and its gardens are now officially recognized and preserved by the government.

items.raw_excerpt: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.
items.summary_en: Theatre producer Francesca Moody shared her secret to spotting successful shows at the Edinburgh Fringe festival. She told NPR that the best approach is to not actively search for a hit. Moody has a track record of discovering shows like Fleabag and Baby Reindeer.

items.summary_en: The Franz Mayer Museum in Mexico City hosts Biodiseño MX, an exhibition that brings together biodesign, ancestral knowledge, and technology. The show explores ways of designing with living systems and non-human perspectives.

items.raw_excerpt: Air quality is expected to be affected between 14 and 15 September by dust from North Africa, prompting the DGS (Directorate-General of Health) to recommend that people avoid outdoor activities and that the most vulnerable stay at home whenever possible.
items.summary_en: Dust blown from the Sahara Desert in North Africa reached Portugal on September 14 and 15. The national health authority warned residents to stay indoors and avoid outdoor activities to protect their health.

items.raw_excerpt: Klagenfurt has brought residence appointments, municipal housing applications, dog registration, and other online city services into one page. Here's how it can make your life easier.

Residents can now handle many administrative tasks without visiting multiple offices. The city hopes the portal will make everyday bureaucracy easier.

items.raw_excerpt: Sqəmáθia, a rock sculpture of a person about a foot and a half tall, was flown home from the Canadian Museum of History in Quebec.
items.summary_en: Tsawwassen First Nation in British Columbia held a ceremony to welcome home Sqəmáθia, a sacred rock sculpture about 50 pounds that was flown back from the Canadian Museum of History. The figure represents a female ancestor turned to stone, and was given to a museum in the 1920s in exchange for a promise that was never kept. Generations later, the nation has both won a land claim treaty and recovered its sacred object.
items.summary_ko: 브리티시컬럼비아의 츠아와센 부족은 캐나다 역사박물관에 보관되어 있던 신성한 바위 조각상 스콰마시아를 되찾아 환영 의식을 열었습니다. 이 조각상은 조개를 너무 많이 모은 죄로 돌이 된 여성 조상을 representations하는 것으로, 1920년대에 박물관에 넘겨졌으나 약속은 지켜지지 않았습니다. 여러 세대가 지난 끝에 부족은 토지 권리 협약을 성사시키고 신성한 유물을 되찾았습니다.
items.title_en: Tsawwassen First Nation welcomes home sacred sculpture after a century
